summary: The PrintJobReportParameters class is designed to handle the retrieval and processing of parameters associated with print jobs in the system. It interacts with the database to obtain parameter data and reformats it for use in application workflows.
purpose: To manage and retrieve parameters related to print jobs, format parameter lists for processing, and ensure proper deletion of print job entries once processed.

fields.name: ParamName
fields.description: The name of the print job parameter.

fields.name: ParamValue
fields.description: The value of the print job parameter.

workflows.name: PrintJobPRDList
steps: Retrieve all parameters for a given PrintJobID using PrintJobGetAllParameters.
Concatenate parameter values with the name 'PRD_ID' into a single list string.
Delete the print job entry after processing parameters.

business_rules: Only parameters with the name 'PRD_ID' are concatenated and returned.

calculations.description: Concatenate ParamValue for all entries with ParamName 'PRD_ID' into a single string separated by commas.

conditions.description: Check if the ParamName is 'PRD_ID' before concatenating.

system_behavior: Deletes the print job entry after processing the parameters.
dependencies: HSPnetSession.DB must provide access to a database connection capable of executing stored procedures.

exceptions.description: Ensure proper handling if the SqlDataReader is null or no parameters are returned.
